description: Compute a cryptographic digest of supplied data: SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-1, SHA3-256, SHA3-512, Keccak-256, BLAKE2b-256 and BLAKE2b-512, plus HMAC with any of them. Input is UTF-8 text, base64 or hex bytes; output is hex, base64, base64url or base32. Returns the digest, the byte length of the input, and the exact algorithm identifier used. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

algo.description: Digest algorithm. Accepted: sha256, sha384, sha512, sha1, sha3-256, sha3-512, keccak256, blake2b-256, blake2b-512.

data.description: Input data, interpreted per encoding. At most 8192 characters. An empty value hashes the empty string. Accepted: at most 8192 characters.

encoding.description: Encoding of data: utf8 (default), base64, base64url or hex. Accepted: utf8, base64, base64url, hex.

hmac_key.description: If present, computes HMAC with this key. Accepted: at most 512 characters.

hmac_key_encoding.description: Encoding of hmac_key, as encoding. Accepted: utf8, base64, base64url, hex.

out.description: Digest output encoding: hex (default), base64, base64url or base32. Accepted: hex, base64, base64url, base32.

name: code_hash
title: SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE2 and HMAC digests of supplied text or base64 bytes
